meta.description: Partner with CNFS - Sponsorship packages, benefits, and how to support Centrale Nantes Formula Student.
meta.ogDescription: Support CNFS - sponsorship packages from 500EUR. Invest in the future of engineering.

props.title: Invest in the Future of Engineering
body: By partnering with CNFS, you support hands-on engineering education while gaining visibility among 20 future engineers and the wider Centrale Nantes community.

items: Brand visibility on the car, team uniforms, website, and social media
Recruitment access to top engineering talent from Centrale Nantes
Event presence at Formula Student competitions across Europe
CSR value - support STEM education and student initiatives
Technical collaboration - test your products in a real engineering environment

header.label: Current Partners
header.title: Our Sponsors
header.intro: We are actively building our sponsor portfolio for the 2025/2026 season. Be among the first to support CNFS.

left.label: Beyond Financial Support
left.title: In-Kind Partnerships
body: We also welcome partnerships through donations of materials, components, software licenses, tools, and technical expertise.

In-kind sponsors receive equivalent visibility and benefits based on the value of their contribution. This is an excellent way for companies to showcase their products in a real engineering context while supporting student innovation.

cards.title: Materials
cards.text: Steel, aluminium, composites, fasteners, raw materials for chassis and bodywork.

cards.title: Software
cards.text: CAD, FEA, CFD, data acquisition, and ECU tuning software licenses.

cards.title: Components
cards.text: Engine parts, brakes, bearings, electronics, sensors, tyres, and wheels.

cards.title: Expertise
cards.text: Technical mentorship, workshop access, manufacturing support, and training.

props.title: Let's Build Something Together
props.text: Whether financial or in-kind, every partnership helps us bring our car to the starting grid. Contact us to discuss a tailored partnership.
